# Coach Himanshu - NASM Certified Online Fitness Coach

> Coach Himanshu is a NASM Certified online fitness coach providing personalized workout plans, custom Indian meal plans, and expert nutrition guidance to 1000+ clients across India and internationally. Plans start from INR 799/month.

## About Coach Himanshu
- NASM Certified Personal Trainer (CPT)
- NASM Bodybuilding Coach
- NASM Sports Nutrition Specialist
- NASM Corrective Exercise Specialist
- 6+ years of coaching experience
- 1000+ client transformations
- Specializes in home workouts, gym training, rehabilitation, and nutrition

## Services Offered
- Home Workout Plans (INR 799/month) - No equipment needed, personalized for home training
- Gym Kickstart Plan (INR 1,099/month) - Structured gym-based training programs
- Consistency Plan (INR 2,499/3 months) - 3-month transformation programs
- Rehabilitation Plans (INR 1,499/month) - Injury recovery and corrective exercise
- Live 1-on-1 Training (INR 5,999/12 sessions) - Real-time video coaching
- Elite Plans (INR 9,999-29,999) - Premium intensive coaching packages

## What Every Plan Includes
- Personalized workout plan tailored to individual goals
- Custom Indian meal plan based on food preferences
- Exercise video tutorials for proper form
- Supplement guidance and recommendations
- 24/7 WhatsApp support for daily accountability
- Weekly one-on-one consultations

## Key Differentiators
- All coaching is online and accessible from anywhere
- Meal plans built around Indian foods (vegetarian and non-vegetarian)
- Affordable pricing starting at INR 799/month
- Certified expertise (NASM) with scientific approach
- Covers special populations: PCOS, diabetes, hypertension, post-injury
- Available in English and Hindi

## Target Audience
- Beginners starting their fitness journey
- Working professionals with busy schedules
- Women dealing with PCOS, hormonal issues
- People wanting to lose weight or build muscle
- Seniors needing age-appropriate training
- Athletes seeking performance optimization
- Post-injury rehabilitation clients
